hyperedges.label: HattonHills multilingual TTS routing (ElevenLabs EN, OpenAI/Azure SI, Azure TA, ElevenLabs AR)
SLIC claim dispatch pipeline (verify → collect → dispatch → SMS)
Agent → dashboard_client → /api/webhooks/agent-events event flow
Kavya TTS routing by language: en→ElevenLabs (ConversationRelay), ar→ElevenLabs (Media Streams), si/ta→Azure (Media Streams)
Shared Yanolja PMS client pattern used by both Kavya and HattonHills agents — JWT auth, lazy login, 401 refresh+retry
ChromaDB RAG pattern shared across agents: delete-before-upsert, sentence-transformer embeddings, semantic search
Kavya booking pipeline: tools.py → kpms_service → kpms_client → booking-pms API
Flico language → TTS routing: EN=ElevenLabs CR, TA=ElevenLabs Media Streams, SI=OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts
Post-call data flow: transcript → LLM extraction → n8n webhook → Google Sheet / Sentinel dashboard
Multi-agent TTS provider routing pattern (language->provider dispatch)
hyperedges.note: All voice agents implement a _speak() dispatch pattern: language code determines TTS provider (ElevenLabs eleven_multilingual_v2 for Tamil/Arabic, Azure Neural for Sinhala, OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts for HattonHills Sinhala)

hyperedges.label: Knowledge base update pipeline (dashboard -> /kb-reload -> agent ChromaDB)
hyperedges.note: Dashboard stores KB content in sentinel_kb, kb-service converts PDFs to markdown, agents expose /kb-reload to hot-reload ChromaDB without container restart

hyperedges.label: Sentinel dual-authentication system (admin vs client portal)
hyperedges.note: Middleware gates /admin on sentinel_admin cookie and /agents on client_session cookie; adminDb has separate admin and client tables with bcrypt password hashing and AES-GCM encrypted secrets

hyperedges.label: HattonHills multilingual TTS routing flow
hyperedges.rationale: All four nodes together implement the language-aware TTS routing in Tanya: Unicode detection selects Azure (Sinhala/Tamil) or ElevenLabs (English), with voice/model chosen per-script.

hyperedges.label: BSL identity verification pipeline
hyperedges.rationale: These four functions form the BSL identity verification pipeline: account normalization, spoken-digit expansion, and phonetic maiden-name matching all feed into verify_identity().

hyperedges.label: Dashboard billing + quota notification subsystem
hyperedges.rationale: These four nodes form the end-to-end quota notification pipeline: quota calculation triggers audit writes which are queried by the notifications API and surfaced to clients.

hyperedges.label: Shared ChromaDB RAG Pattern (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, 500-char chunks, SHA-256 IDs)
SLIC 5-Step Tool Chain: verify_vehicle -> collect_details -> dispatch -> sms -> handoff
Pluggable LLM Provider Pattern (Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini formats)
Multilingual TTS Routing Pattern: detect language → route to Azure (si/ta) or ElevenLabs (en)
KB Hot-Reload Pipeline: admin portal → /kb-reload endpoint → stale-chunk delete → re-upsert ChromaDB
Post-Call Pipeline: transcript → LLM extraction (Claude/OpenAI/Gemini) → n8n webhook → Google Sheets → dashboard
Booking service pattern (derive_availability + book + lookup + cancel)
hyperedges.description: All three implement the same booking/session lifecycle pattern across HattonHills (KPMS PMS), Kavya (Yanolja PMS), and Flico (Supabase). Shared pattern: local availability computation, guest upsert, reservation creation, post-call persistence.

hyperedges.label: Billing reporting surface (admin + client billing pages + API route)
hyperedges.description: Admin billing report page, client billing page, per-agent billing API route, and per-client Twilio aggregate route all draw from the same Twilio subaccount call data at Rs. 3/min, sharing KPI computation and date-range filtering logic.

hyperedges.label: Human handoff signaling (BSL verbal, Kavya ConversationRelay end, dashboard detection)
hyperedges.description: All three encode the same concept of handing a caller to a human: BSL uses a verbal-only tool with no call hang-up, Kavya's plan uses ConversationRelay end-session + Twilio Dial, and the agent-dashboard's handover.ts detects handover from transcript text patterns.
